the tube burning rate increases with increasing tube diameter, tube wall thickness, tube wall thermal conductivity, and tube wall density and decreases with increasing propellant thermal conductivity, gas temperature, and propellant burning rate.

burning rates of embedded tubes can be controlled by varying tube geometry, propellant thermophysical properties, and combustion gas flow.
